split: validation only: 607 pairs, existing paireval.InScope expected 553 before tokenizer exclusions
model: existing checksum-pinned code-int8-v2 ONNX checkpoint; no refitting or prompt sweep
instruction: Which statement best describes the relationship between the request and the code?
options: The code does not implement the request.
order_control: Run both option orders; primary score is arithmetic mean of the probability assigned to implements. Report each order AUC and mean absolute score difference.
truncation: Exclude from all matched metrics if either order truncates; report exclusions explicitly
control: BM25 fitted on development code only, measured on exactly the same eligible validation pairs
exploratory_gate: primary AUC >= 0.60 and >= matched BM25 AUC + 0.03
resource_guard: One native session, sequential cases, at most 60 minutes; check current process RSS <= 8 GiB between cases. This is not a within-call memory hard limit.
reporting: Aggregate metrics and resource summaries only; no raw texts or row predictions in Git
scope: Teacher-signal probe, not a tiny model or proved semantic representation; no reserve scoring, model publication, default change or LLM savings claim
